item.strawgolem.golem_directory.tooltip3: Sneak + right-click for a roll call - the crew lights up.

screen.strawgolem.directory.tip.0: Your little buddy needs a place to put the finished product - but don't put too many down, or you'll end up with iron ingots in your soup chest.
screen.strawgolem.directory.tip.1: A golem delivers to the NEAREST chest it can reach. Keep a trade's chest close, and rival chests far.
screen.strawgolem.directory.tip.2: A full chest stops a crew cold. They'll route around it, but nobody gets paid.
screen.strawgolem.directory.tip.3: A hungry golem is a slow golem. Keep the Lunch Cart stocked and they keep pace.
screen.strawgolem.directory.tip.4: Name a golem with a name tag - it sticks through retraining, refits and a trip in the bindle.
item.strawgolem.profession_badge.tooltip: Pin on a straw golem to hire it for this trade.

item.strawgolem.golem_carrier.tooltip_em: Right-click a golem to tuck it in for moving day.
item.strawgolem.golem_carrier.tooltip_fu: Right-click a block to set the little guy back down.
item.strawgolem.golem_carrier.flavor: Holds one golem, and only a golem. Rank and trade ride along.
strawgolem.carrier.captured: %s is packed and ready to travel

strawgolem.carrier.failed: That golem won't fit right now - try again

item.strawgolem.golem_retrainer.tooltip: Wipes a golem's memory and assigns it a new trade.
item.strawgolem.golem_retrainer.tooltip2: Tested by generations of brave straw workers. Most survived.
advancement.strawgolem.workforce.root.de: In memory of Timmy I-IV, pioneers of golem workplace safety.

item.strawgolem.immortal_soul.tooltip2: It will also never learn again. Choose the moment well.
